_comment: One 2x2x2 corner cube, at the north-west-down corner in this base orientation.
It fills the end of a horizontal frame bar when energy_cell_edge_v is NOT emitted there - that is,
when the perpendicular horizontal neighbour is another cell. edge_v is emitted only when BOTH its
faces are exposed, so the two are exactly complementary: every corner is covered by edge_v or by
this cap, never by both and never by neither.
Faces rotate correctly with the model: north/west/down here become east/north/down at y=90, and
south/west/up under x=180, which is what each of those corners needs.
